messages.content: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space_star_info

information.description: The type of information needed about the star.

message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius roughly 2–3 times that of Jupiter (about 20–30 % larger than the next‑biggest known exoplanets). Its mass is estimated to be around 10–15 Jupiter masses, making it one of the most massive “planetary” bodies ever found.  

Because exoplanet surveys are still ongoing, it’s possible that even larger planets will be discovered in the future. For now, though, HD 100546 b holds the record for the biggest planet we know of.
